text:
leo: Aurora Dynamics (acct 3220) replied to our overdue notice for INV-2026-058. they claim a 'burst overage' on 2026-05-28 was unexpected and ask us to pause collections while they escalate to finance. attached a short screenshot.

tara: can you paste the invoice lines theyre calling out? i'll pull the meter logs.

leo: pasted snippet:

```
INV-2026-058
Date: 2026-05-31
Total: $14,420.00
1) Platform subscription: $9,000.00
2) Usage (tokens): $3,000.00
3) Burst overage (2026-05-28): $1,420.00  <-- disputed
```

collections-bot: automated: dunning reminder sent to billing@auroradyn.com for INV-2026-058 on 2026-06-04 13:10 UTC.

vince: pulling meter for 2026-05-28. i see a short 12-minute spike where a batch job retried and the meter registered two overlapping windows; our sliding-window aggregator double-counted 1,420 tokens in peak window. root cause looks like metering-window edge case when job retries overlap bucket boundary.

tara: ok looks like it's a legit platform error. recommend full credit of the $1,420 and pause dunning. this is under collections credit threshold.

leo: collections policy confirmed: credits <= $2k can be approved by collections manager. i'll proceed to issue credit and pause any escalation emails.

collections-bot: automated: collections workflow paused for INV-2026-058 by collections (leo) at 2026-06-04 13:52 UTC.

leo: created credit memo CM-2026-048 for $1,420 and applied to INV-2026-058. regenerated invoice INV-2026-058-R1 with new balance $13,000. linked ticket ZD-4768. invoice link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-058-R1 (shows credit pending).

aurora.billing (via email paste): thanks for quick response. CFO says they are short this quarter and asked if we can offer a hardship payment plan (4 payments) to avoid chargebacks.

vince: collections note: for remaining balance $13,000 we can offer a 4-installment hardship plan as a one-off: 25% due now ($3,250), then 3 monthly installments of $3,250 each. waive late fees for this invoice cycle. require ACH or card on file and sign-off from AM. if they miss first payment, plan cancels and normal dunning resumes.

tara: agree but add: require a signed payment plan agreement (I can draft) and set calendar reminders. also flag for salesOps if they request further concessions.

leo: drafted reply to Aurora: we've applied a $1,420 credit for an internal metering issue and can offer a 4-installment payment plan: $3,250 now, then $3,250 on 30/60/90 days. we'll waive late fees for this cycle and attach the payment plan agreement. please confirm payment method and sign the agreement. cc'ing your AM.

aurora.billing: acknowledged and requested the payment agreement. will confirm payment method within 48 hours.

vince: created ENG ticket ENG-9341 to fix the sliding-window aggregation for retries and added replication steps and job IDs. assigned to eng-runtime. please track PR and rollback risk.

collections-bot: automated: follow-up reminder set for 2026-06-10 to check for signed agreement and first payment.

leo: logging internal note: if Aurora signs the plan but misses payment, escalate to salesOps for relationship review and re-open dunning. also log recovery path if chargeback appears.

tara: i'll draft the payment agreement and attach to ZD-4768. calendar follow-ups: 2026-06-10 (first payment), 2026-07-10, 2026-08-10, 2026-09-10.

leo: thanks team. small ops ask: finance ops to add a template for hardship plans to speed approvals. tagging ops. :white_check_mark:
